purpose: Bounded public-project chronology pilot; candidates are not training labels
selection: First 40 frozen public seeds in round-robin Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go order; 10 per language; no replacement of failed sources
source_license_policy: Pinned MIT repository license and no conflicting file SPDX notice; source-file scope requires later review
history_policy: First-parent commit order observed; one prior same-file one-line replacement and one later same-file one-line target; no invented within-commit order
acceptance: No candidate accepted without exact replay, source-file rights, prompt-budget check, blind inferability review, and independent objective check
expansion_gate: At least 24 independently accepted candidates among 40 attempted repositories, with at least 5 per target language and no unresolved license or split violation
